os: Linux container on managed Linux VM
storage: Docker disk-backed named volume on overlay-backed host; tmpfs only for ENOSPC correctness probes

native_settings.wal_checkpoint: TRUNCATE before build and each separate mutation phase; disabled auto-checkpoint

network: unrestricted HTTP policy; CA trusted via CARGO_HTTP_CAINFO, no credential values recorded
timing_policy: Fresh sequential processes, forward/reverse paired candidates. No other benchmarks/build/tests while timing.
